blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال هذا حديث غريب باب حديث في اسماء الله....، رقم: ٣٥٠٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Allah has ninety-nine names (one less than a hundred). Whoever memorises them well will enter Jannah. He is Allah, besides whom there is none worthy of worship. He is (the 99 attributive names are as follows) (1)the Most Gracious beyond measure (2)the Incomparably Merciful (3) the True King (4)the One Pure from all defects (5)the One Secure from all harm (6)the Giver of refuge and security (7)the One who takes full charge (8)the One who overpowers all things (9)the One who sets right what is broken (10)the One full of greatness (11)the Creator (12)the One who creates perfectly (13) the Fashioner of forms (14)the One who forgives sins abundantly (15)the One who holds all things under His control (16)the One who gives lavishly (17) the One who fulfils needs abundantly (18) the One who opens the doors of Rahmah for all (19)the All-Knowing (20) the One who gives constriction (21)the One who gives abundance (22)the One who lowers (23)the One who raises (24)the Giver of honour (25)the One who humiliates (26)the One who hears all things (27)the One who sees everything (28) the One who judges decisively (29)the One of complete justice (30)the One who knows what is in the hearts (31)the One who knows all news (32) the One full of forbearance (33)the One full of majesty (34)the One who forgives greatly (35)the Appreciative, who gives much in return for little (36)the One of exalted
